name: Sterling-Nakamura Heritage Roadster
description: A hand-built electric sports car styled to evoke pre-collapse automotive design — long hood, swept fenders, leather interior, chrome trim. Each Heritage is manufactured to order with a six-month wait list. Only 200 exist in GLMZ. Owning one says you are wealthy enough to spend Φ150,000 on nostalgia for an era you never experienced. The Heritage is objectively inferior to a SkyLux in every practical measure. That is entirely the point. It is a beautiful, impractical, ground-bound statement that you can afford to waste money on beauty.
autonomy: Manual drive with optional assist. Owners drive these themselves — that's the point.
armament: None. The beauty is its defense.
common_usage: Recreational driving, status display, corporate social events, mid-life crises.
story_hooks: A Heritage Roadster is found crashed in a tunnel with no driver — the door locks were engaged from outside
The Heritage owner community is a social network of Tier 5 elites, and someone is infiltrating it by acquiring stolen vehicles
physical_description: The Heritage Roadster is a sleek, low-slung machine with a stretched hood and gracefully swept fenders, its lines evoking pre-collapse muscle car aesthetics. Hand-stitched leather seats in deep burgundy sit beneath a frameless windshield, while polished chrome trim catches the neon glow of the GLMZ streets. The body is immaculate—a sharp contrast to the worn infrastructure around it—finished in pearl white or matte charcoal, its electric drivetrain humming silently beneath.
